subject: general
question: In a certain code language the word ‘TEACHER’ is written as ‘RCYAFCP’. The word ‘SCHOOL’ is written as ‘QAFMMJ’. How will the word ‘SUBJECT’ be written in the same language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] Logic : (2) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series. ​So, • ‘TEACHER’ is written as ‘RCYAFCP’​
